key_insight: MMControl provides a unified, multi-modal control interface for joint audio–video diffusion transformers, enabling explicit, simultaneous control of both audio and video and improving cross-modal synchronization and alignment.
problem_solved: Existing controllable generation methods focus on video-only control, which prevents fine-grained steering of audio and often yields suboptimal audio–video alignment; MMControl fills this gap by enabling joint, consistent control across modalities.
method: Extend a joint audio–video DiT backbone to accept and condition on heterogeneous control signals (e.g., visual cues, audio cues, and textual prompts).
Introduce lightweight conditioning/adapter modules and cross-modal attention mechanisms to align control inputs and enforce synchronized generation.
Train the model with joint objectives that encourage temporal and semantic consistency between generated audio and video.
impact: Allows AI/ML practitioners to precisely steer both audio and video in a single model, improving creative control and producing better-synchronized multimodal outputs for content creation, simulation, and research on cross-modal generation.

paper_title: MMControl: Unified Multi-Modal Control for Joint Audio-Video Generation
paper_authors: Liyang Li, Wen Wang, Canyu Zhao, Tianjian Feng, Zhiyue Zhao
